checks.detail: subprocess env TZ=UTC (this shell: TZ=None; not used by the JVM unless passed)

strat_config.model_note: XGBoost library defaults + scale_pos_weight = n_benign / n_attack of EACH model's own training rows (build_model); features_v1.json (70, float32); no search
strat_config.seed_note: seed 42 only (XGB scores were identical across seeds 42 / 7 / 123 in round 2); the dry-run subsample is bakeoff's (CONFIG seed, strata = v1.0 group / y / attack_family)
strat_config.grouping_rule: config/groupings/<strategy>.json: devices (MAC -> group) and device_info (MAC -> device_name); a row's device name -> MAC -> group
strat_config.gen_rule: GEN devices are scored by the GLOBAL model (every train row) in every strategy

mode_rules.pure: the group's own train rows (benign + attack)
mode_rules.shared_attack: the group's own train BENIGN rows + every train attack row of every device (08's caps as built, no resampling)

strat_config.global_mode_note: The GLOBAL model trains on every train row, so pure == shared_attack; strategy global runs once (mode 'both')
strat_config.common_threshold_rule: ONE threshold for every model of the strategy: the lowest observed house val score with <= max_fp FP on the whole house's val benign (budget per HOUSE, not per group)
strat_config.session_threshold_rule: the same rule on the house's val rows outside the held-out session (the threshold never sees that session)
strat_config.benign_holdout_rule: every model of the strategy refit on its training rows minus the held-out session's benign rows (every device; every attack row kept)
strat_config.rotation_rule: every model of the strategy refit on its training rows minus every row of the held-out session (attack + benign, every device)
strat_config.held_benign: (i) the held-out session's benign rows, train + val splits, every device
strat_config.val_benign: (ii) every val benign row of the house (includes the held-out session's own val benign rows)
strat_config.held_syn: the held-out session's syn_flood rows, train + val splits, every device
strat_config.scoring_rule: every row is scored exactly once, by the model that owns its device under the strategy
strat_config.fit_dedup: a fit is keyed by its exact training row positions; identical training sets (e.g. behaviour_k2 G1 == behaviour_k3 G1, GLOBAL in every strategy) share one fit (XGB is deterministic here)
strat_config.latency: 1 thread: dict lookup MAC -> model, then that model's predict_proba on one flow; CONFIG latency single_calls calls over val rows sampled once (seed 42), the same rows for every strategy; one full pass over every strategy is run and discarded first (warm-up), then the measured pass
strat_config.size: sum of the strategy's models' joblib sizes (the Pi loads every model)
strat_config.fit_time: sum of the strategy's models' fit times (all cores); a shared fit counts in every strategy using it

config.global_note: GLOBAL = all train / val rows (G1 + G2 + GEN devices), same splits

excluded_models.1D-CNN: round 1 is per-flow input; windowed input is a separate design axis

config.hyperparameters: library defaults + class-weight handling only; no search

LR.reason: convergence fix, not tuning (lbfgs stopped at 100 iterations with a ConvergenceWarning on GLOBAL)

class_weight.XGB: scale_pos_weight = n_benign / n_attack of the group's train
class_weight.MLP: sample_weight=compute_sample_weight('balanced') if MLPClassifier.fit takes sample_weight, else random oversampling of the minority class in TRAIN

non_hyperparameter_settings.n_jobs / thread_count: fit and full-val scoring use all cores (fit_n_jobs); latency and throughput use 1 thread

config.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN only, applied to the 70 features + zero_duration_flag
config.threshold_rule: flag attack iff score >= threshold; budget points pick the lowest observed val score whose val FP/hour <= budget (allowed FP = floor(budget * hours))
